sections.text_helper: Section 56.7.11 "TIMx prescaler (TIMx_PSC)(x = 9, 12)" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2805.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x028
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:0 PSC[15:0]: Prescaler value
The counter clock frequency tim_cnt_ck is equal to ftim_psc_ck / (PSC[15:0] + 1).
PSC contains the value to be loaded into the active prescaler register at each update event.
(including when the counter is cleared through UG bit of TIMx_EGR register or through
trigger controller when configured in “reset mode”).
